title: SQM Q1 2026 Form 6-K earnings release
excerpt: Q1 2026 revenue was USD 1.76 billion, net income was USD 364.7 million, adjusted EBITDA was USD 837 million, and lithium-equivalent sales volume was 69 thousand tonnes.
summary: The unchanged SEC-filed Q1 release remains the latest earnings evidence and retains the operating-recovery, state-take, partnership-attribution, capex and normalized-valuation checklist.
